# gramlot-examples 0.3.35 — Gallery lessons and reactive charts

- Fundamentals introduces Data, bindings, labels and styles with minimal Python and JavaScript.
- Per-example JSON metadata, searchable tags and Markdown lessons; sample Data companions keep code focused.
- Dedicated checkBoxText, hierarchical checkboxes, grid sets, primary supplier and column/date filters.
- Charts section with simple, time, 3D and map examples; original server-backed sales and geographic reports remain available through their environment.
- Drawing annotations and live audio/system-monitor lessons, using shared components.
- Compact controls, detachable Example/Explanation/Code, remembered lesson view and optional single-page navigation.

Qualification: all 115 Python tests passed. Full JavaScript sweep passed 418 tests with one Drawing initialization finding; that finding was corrected and all 14 affected checks passed. No Invoice application is included.

## Browser qualification

Register all new grid, chart and drawing lessons in the complete-gallery behavioral gate; reuse the chart interaction checks in the focused chart qualifier. Public Python deployment includes the original chart report resources and existing read-only database provider.

## Qualification host corrections

The complete-gallery browser gate follows the current Fundamentals lessons and serves the standard collection assets from the installed core. Node and Bun test hosts share one import-map registration helper, loading real component modules. Python test dependencies include the asynchronous test runner used by the monitor checks. Endpoint parity retains the full catalogue with a five-minute test budget.

Local qualification after these corrections: all 141 pages pass behavioral browser checks through both Python and JavaScript hosts; live Source identity and timer cleanup pass in both languages; the 143 affected mounting/editing tests pass on Node and Bun. Official publication repeats the complete automatic gate.
